youtube.title: Why LPG Gas Smells Bad (A School Lost 295 Lives)
youtube.description: Your gas cylinder stinks, but the gas inside has no smell at all. So who decided it should? In 1937, a school in New London, Texas, filled with an odourless leak and about 295 people died with no warning. Gas odorants already existed, but that disaster made warning smells the law. The ethyl mercaptan in your kitchen is why you notice a leak long before a spark does. The Hidden Why explains the real reason behind things you use every day. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
